content:
The v4.19.0 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language.

Of particular note: parallel elaboration of theorems within a file has now arrived!

Please read the release notes for details.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.19.0.

  • there is a v4.19.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
